name: Ayanokouji Reina
source: The daughter of [url=/c76327]Hikaru[/url] and Kousuke. She attends her parents' old high school. She bumps into the protagonist not knowing who he is and calls him a stalker. She was surprised that he is the new principal at her school. She fell in love with [url=/c32561]Ichijou[/url], her history teacher. Unknown to her, Ichijou and the protagonist are slowly brainwashing her.
